title: At the doctor's
grammar: What's the matter? + must / mustn't (health advice)

scene.speaker: erik
scene.bubble: Mateo's dentist day! Don't worry — Doctor Ana counts your teeth and gives you a sticker. Science says: painless!
scene.intro: Mateo's dentist day, and he is NOT happy. Open your mouth, please, says the dentist. You must brush your teeth twice a day, and you mustn't eat sweets every afternoon. Erik takes notes, because he wants to invent a toothbrush that works alone. The medicine tastes terrible but the tooth is strong again. What's the matter? Ask the doctor, and do what she says!

data.voice_note: Voces: Mateo (valiente) y la dentista Ana (voz adulta amable).
data.script: Mateo: Hello, Doctor Ana. I'm a little nervous. … Mateo: She says: open your mouth, please. One, two, three… she's counting my teeth! … Mateo: Twenty-four teeth, all strong! … Mateo: She says I should brush for two minutes, morning and night. … Mateo: And I shouldn't eat sweets every day. Only on Saturdays! … Mateo: The best part: the sticker box. I choose the dinosaur sticker. … Mateo: See you in six months, Doctor Ana!
